outcome: Static named world references are available to selectively informed Controllers and read-only Metrics
owner_impact: Experiments can define named static point references in Initialization, choose exactly which agents can sense each reference with finite or unlimited range, branch in one shared Controller on per-agent availability, read the local minimum-image relative-position vector when available, and analyze the same canonical reference position in Metrics. Named sensing is direct over configured agent-reference links, not a broad world search. The reference state remains structured for a future separately approved dynamics mechanism, but this scope adds no dynamic motion or optional executable artifact.

next.text: The approved #501 static named-world-reference capability scope is complete with #504 and the epic is being closed. No owner action or rebuild of the earlier scientific experiment is required. The separately reported Mac syntax-highlighting bugs/changes are a different follow-up lane and have not started in this ticket.

technical_evidence: Initialization emits vlab.world-references/0.1; browser and MCP Controller/Metrics compilers consume the same declared reference names and remain mirrored.

Rust generates Controller reference observations only for configured agent-reference sensor links that pass their finite/unlimited range rule; relative geometry reuses the simulator minimum-image helper and an unavailable reference has no vector entry.
Controller exposes obs.references.<name>.available and obs.references.<name>.relative_position; Metrics exposes snapshot.references.<name>.position from the same simulator-owned reference state.
Unit regressions cover informed/uninformed availability, finite range, periodic minimum-image geometry, Controller relative-position execution and Metrics reference-position reads.
Dynamic references, optional executable-artifact dispatch, arbitrary world-object discovery and paper-specific pursuit/capture behavior remain outside this completed scope.

Production browser smoke edits through live Ace, waits for the unified Experiment Authoring runtime state to report clean (without treating stale legacy per-artifact feedback as authoritative), preserves the syntax-highlighting assertion, and verifies a live Metric computed from the canonical reference position.
